statement.p: Find the velocity \vec{v}(t) and the speed \|\vec{v}(t)\| of a particle with position x = 4t^{3}-12t^{2},\quad y = 7,\quad z = 3t^{2}-12t+12.
Find any times at which the particle stops.

p.em: (Give your answer as a time or list of times, comma separated.)

static.solution: \vec{v} is given by: \vec{v} = \frac{d}{dt}(4t^{3}-12t^{2})\vec i+\frac{d}{dt}(7)\vec j+ \frac{d}{dt}(3t^{2}-12t+12)\vec k = (12t\mathopen{}\left(t-2\right))\,\vec i + (0)\,\vec j + (6\mathopen{}\left(t-2\right))\,\vec k. The speed is given by: \|\vec v\|=\sqrt{(12t\mathopen{}\left(t-2\right))^{2} + (0)^{2} + (6\mathopen{}\left(t-2\right))^2} = 6|t - 2|\sqrt{ 1 + 4 t^2}. The particle stops when \vec v = \vec 0, so when t = 2. Since this is the only time when all components of the velocity are zero, it is the only time that the particle stops.
